candidates.change_summary: Change the stored target block from block.number + 1 to block.number, altering which block's hash is later checked in settle.
Delete the require(guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) check so users can re-lock and overwrite an existing guess.
Delete the require(msg.value == 1 ether) check so lockInGuess can be called with any amount of ether.
Store a hashed value instead of the raw hash, changing the guess recorded on-chain and thus settle's win condition.
Delete the statement `guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;` so guesses are never cleared and settle() can succeed repeatedly.
Replace the transfer amount `2 ether` with `1 ether`, paying only half the reward on a winning guess.
Delete the `payable(msg.sender).transfer(2 ether);` statement so winners are never paid.
Replace `blockhash(guesses[msg.sender].block)` with `blockhash(block.number)` so the answer is always the zero hash and no one can ever win.
